From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-12 10:00:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@rioplatagrainexports.example
Cc: mail01@gannetcrestmaritime.example
Subject: RE: VSL-16 - TIME LOST HOLD CLEANING - OFF-HIRE

Dear Charterers,

Operator: cleaning on charterers' orders is for charterers' time unless the CP says otherwise; the CP clause 28 requires cleaning at owners' expense but the time stays on hire; the chemicals are owners' cost; proposes the time as on-hire and owners paying the chemicals.

- Cp clause: clause 28
- Chemicals: 2300.0 USD

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@rioplatagrainexports.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 11:20:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@gannetcrestmaritime.example
Subject: VSL-16 - TIME LOST HOLD CLEANING - OFF-HIRE

Dear Colleagues,

Charterer asks to treat the 33.5 hours from the failed inspection (8 Oct 14:00) to the pass (10 Oct 02:00) as off-hire and to bear the cost of the hold washing chemicals USD 2,300.

- Reclean: 33.5 hours
- Claim offhire: 33.5 hours
- Chemicals: 2300.0 USD

Best regards,
Rioplata Grain Exports

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@cargoinspectionservicesrosario.example
Sent: 2026-10-10 02:30:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Cc: mail01@rioplatagrainexports.example; mail01@paranariveragency.example
Subject: VSL-16 HOLD RE-INSPECTION REPORT - ACCEPTED

Dear Colleagues,

Holds 2 and 5 pass the re-inspection at 02:00 on 10 Oct; vessel may berth.

- Reinspection passed: 2026-10-10 02:00
- Reclean: 33.5 hours

Best regards,
Cargo Inspection Services Rosario

-----Original Message-----
From: mail01@meridianfleet.example
Sent: 2026-10-08 18:05:00 UTC+08:00
To: mail01@vslgannetcrest.example
Cc: mail01@rioplatagrainexports.example
Subject: RE: VSL-16 HOLD INSPECTION REPORT - NOT ACCEPTED

Dear Captain,

Operator instructs the master to re-clean holds 2 and 5 at anchorage with the crew; estimate 30 hours; asks the charterer to confirm the delay is for the account of the CP clause 28 (cleaning to the inspector's satisfaction).

- Reclean: 30.0 hours
- Cp clause: clause 28

Best regards,
Meridian Fleet Management
